title: Definitions of the technician tiers and of a technician's direct supervision
subtopic: Technician tier definitions and direct supervision
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 2.00 a Pharmacy Technician is an individual who is registered by the Board, pursuant to 247 CMR 8.02, who performs pharmacy duties under the direct supervision of a pharmacist; a Pharmacy Technician Trainee is an individual preparing to be registered as a pharmacy technician who performs pharmacy duties under the direct supervision of a pharmacist; and a Certified Pharmacy Technician is a pharmacy technician who is currently registered by the Board and certified by a Board-approved certifying body. A pharmacy technician may perform the duties authorized to be performed by a certified pharmacy technician in 247 CMR 8.04 when Board-approved certification is current, and if certification lapses the individual is required to function as a pharmacy technician until certification is current. Direct Supervision, as it applies to a pharmacy technician, is the type of supervision a registered pharmacist in a pharmacy, pharmacy department, hospital pharmacy, or institutional pharmacy is required to provide a pharmacy technician when the pharmacist oversees and directs the activities of the pharmacy technician. Under 247 CMR 8.04(1) and (2), no individual may work as a certified pharmacy technician without holding a valid pharmacy technician license from the Board, and a certified pharmacy technician means a pharmacy technician that is certified by a Board-approved certifying body.
exam_relevance: Tests that the pharmacy technician, like the trainee, performs pharmacy duties under a pharmacist's direct supervision, and that certified status is current certification by a Board-approved certifying body held on top of the Board's pharmacy technician license rather than a separate Board credential.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations
authority.section: 247 CMR 2.00, definitions of Certified Pharmacy Technician, Direct Supervision (b), Pharmacy Technician and Pharmacy Technician Trainee

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: Direct supervision is not a trainee-only condition: the 247 CMR 2.00 definitions place the pharmacy technician under it as well.
The Board issues the pharmacy technician license; certification comes from a Board-approved certifying body and must be current.
verification_notes: Read in the official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publications of 247 CMR 2.00 and 247 CMR 8.00 (the mass.gov PDFs) on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
